map.第一次进入不必急着深入堆场，按下面的顺序熟悉操作，能减少迷路和误触：: On your first run, do not rush into the yard. Follow this order to learn the controls and avoid wrong turns:
map.先站稳：在出生区域用 W A S D 小步移动，缓慢移动鼠标确认视角方向；如果转: Get steady: move in short steps with W A S D near the spawn area and move the mouse slowly to confirm look direction. If turning feels too fast, lower sensitivity first.
map.再熟悉位移：找一段开阔通道练习 Shift 冲刺，再按 C 蹲下，比较两种状态下: Learn movement: find an open corridor, practice Shift sprint, then C crouch, and compare speed and eye height in each state.
map.练习瞄准：对准墙面或空旷处的目标点按左键射击，先停稳再射，观察准星与命中反馈，然: Practice aim: fire at a wall or open target with left click, stopping before each shot to watch the crosshair and hit feedback, then try moving shots.
map.开始探索：沿泊位、集装箱堆场、冷链仓储和多式联运区域逐段推进；遇到岔路先记住显眼: Start exploring: advance section by section through berths, container yards, cold-chain storage, and the intermodal area. At junctions, note a distinctive container or sign before choosing a direction.
map.随时暂停：按 Esc 回到操作速览核对按键；若页面卡住，先刷新本介绍页，再重新打: Pause anytime: press Esc to return to the control overview. If the page freezes, refresh this introduction page and launch the demo again.
map.不同设备的手感差异很大，建议先做一轮低强度适应，再逐步提高难度：: Feel differs widely across devices. Start with a low-intensity warm-up, then raise the difficulty gradually:
map.灵敏度循序渐进：鼠标灵敏度从偏低开始，能在集装箱通道中稳定转身后再上调；每次调整: Sensitivity in small steps: start low and raise it only after you can turn smoothly in container lanes. After each change, stand still for a second to check.
map.冲刺看距离：穿越开阔地时用 Shift 缩短暴露时间，进入狭窄堆场或需要精确瞄准: Sprint by distance: use Shift to cross open ground faster, then walk through narrow yards or when you need precise aim.
map.蹲下看掩体：C 蹲下适合借助矮墙、货柜边缘隐藏身形；起身前先确认周围视野，避免突: Crouch behind cover: C works with low walls and container edges. Check the surrounding view before standing up.
map.射击先停稳：远距离目标先站稳再点射，近距离移动目标再尝试连射；准星未落定时不要连: Stabilize before firing: stand still for distant targets and use tap fire; try sustained fire only on close moving targets. Do not spam the button while the crosshair is settling.
map.手机触屏：横屏后双手持机，左手控制移动、右手调整视角；手指不要长期压住射击按钮，: Mobile touch: hold the phone in landscape with both hands, move with the left thumb and look with the right. Avoid resting a finger on the fire button.
map.窗口与全屏：若浏览器地址栏挤占画面，可用全屏显示；切换全屏后重新确认鼠标或触屏仍: Window and fullscreen: use fullscreen if the address bar crowds the view, then confirm mouse or touch look still works.
